acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: Separate user-owned scheduled execution from administrator event workflows. Record scope, next-run timezone, authenticated state and output identity independently; do not treat start as delivered.

Record eligibility blockers separately:pending conflict, wrong matter status or prior completed run. An authorized manual restart creates a distinct run with provenance and action-level idempotency. Repeated form submissions follow F-0374 rather than a global once-only rule.

Build a three-task chain with day/week/month/year offsets. Before completion, show inactive state rather than an overdue task. Complete the predecessor late; calculate from the actual trigger time. Test reopen, duplicate completion, cycle prevention and cross-matter references without silently replaying finished downstream work.

Configure tasks based on a trigger, another task completion and no due date. The dependent task must not exist as active work before the predecessor completes. At zero delay, create it once after verified completion. Reject cycles and stale/replayed events. Preserve four named anchor limits as competitor metadata, not a forced limit on the proposed program.

Use separate incident, retainer, filing and trial dates. Apply the saved intake workflow explicitly against retainer date and verify the intended tasks/events. Do not substitute incident date from shared context. Replay Apply and test a second workflow instance:prevent unintended duplicates while preserving deliberate separate runs.

acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: Create one task with staff/client assignees and five reminders. acceptance_test_variants.title: Role resolution on each case
acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: Assign the same case role to different people on two cases. Resolve each task to the correct person, retain rule/role/actor snapshots, and expose missing or inactive role members.

acceptance_test_variants.title: Separate task assignees from completion ownership
acceptance_test_variants.developer_story_extension: As the administrator, I need tasks assigned to multiple staff without multiplying work or losing who actually completed it.
acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: Assign one synthetic task toA/B, then let permitted userC complete it. Preserve assignees, responsible owner, actual completer and event time separately; completion does not create three activities. Reassign while another user completes: resolve against the current task version and retain both events. Bulk complete two eligible tasks and one denied task with per-item outcomes; retry cannot duplicate completion. Required fields, due date and priority are validated consistently in matter/global and desktop/web paths. No real tasks are changed.

acceptance_test_variants.title: Keep task templates, attachments and history independent

acceptance_test_variants.title: Keep finalized-invoice locks and original activity distinct

acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: Try editing, inline editing, cloning and deleting a synthetic entry on a finalized invoice. Finalize an invoice between preview and commit and reject stale changes without altering source activity. Allowed revisions to saved or draft entries retain the original duration, description, reviewer, change reason and invoice linkage. A permitted clone creates a new identity. A permanent deletion requires explicit reviewed scope and an attributable disposition; it cannot silently erase the underlying call or text. A static status label does not prove enforcement.

acceptance_test_variants.title: Browser-editor Save As versus native-utility tracked path
acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: Test browser PDF-editor Save As creating a new document in Docs, original version intact, and native utility Save As breaking its tracked save path. The same button label has different route semantics. Verify destination/IDs/format and remote receipt; neither local download nor copy creation implies external transmission.

acceptance_test_variants.title: Prepared output, open, local save and filing are separate
acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: Click Download, then test exiting with Complete before opening the prepared orange-bar link. The UI must not claim local bytes were saved. Open the link and save; verify the local file before manual court upload is offered. Test blocked pop-up, expired prepared output and interrupted save with a recoverable retry. Neither generation nor local save can mark a court accepted filing or notice delivered.

acceptance_test_variants.title: Returned certificate isnot court-filed

acceptance_test_variants.title: Download, copy and matter save require different evidence
acceptance_test_variants.scenario_and_expected_result: From the same reviewed draft version test DOCX download, PDF download, clipboard copy, and Save to Manage separately. Verify downloaded bytes/content and destination matter/folder/file ID after save. At a root destination, apply the documented Vincent Generated Content folder policy without duplicating that folder; saving to another permitted folder follows an explicit selection. Test duplicate filename, concurrent save, revoked permission and network failure. A menu choice or success toast in a staged tutorial cannot pass the persistence test; none of these actions establishes send, receipt or filing.

features.observed_documentation_behavior: The page labels transition tasks for version 16; it distinguishes synchronous failure reversal from independent asynchronous jobs after state completion.
features.proposed_program_requirement: As the workflow owner, I need approval-state completion and each side-effect job tracked separately, with safe retries and clear transactional boundaries.

availability.version_limit: Guide retains future wording, butrelease announcement and v16.0.0 code support release-line availability. Exact firmversion, installed modules and runtime behavior unknown.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: In a version-qualified test build, run three synchronous tasks and fail the second:the transition and transactional writes must roll back. If an external webhook already succeeded, record that side effect and compensating action; do not pretend a database rollback unsent it. In asynchronous mode, complete the transition, fail one job and retain its failed status while the approved state remains. Retry with an idempotency key:one external action and one linked result must exist. A missing task capability must block configuration, not silently skip work.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Users A and B open the same synthetic file through different editing routes. Show the holder and start time; permit authorized read/download while denying conflicting edits. Verify normal close and the documented 24-hour expiry separately. Deny override to non-admins; log a permitted override and warn about the active session. Let A save a stale version after B saved: retain both versions and require an explicit conflict decision rather than silently losing B. Reopen the older version and verify its hash and content. Offline save, client crash, clock differences and expired-session callbacks cannot erase another user’s accepted change. Vendor last-save-wins behavior is a documented risk, while preservation/conflict handling here is a proposed safeguard.
